peopleAlsoAsk.question: How do Amish cool their homes without air conditioning?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Many Amish homes are built with plenty of windows to help circulate the air and bring in the cooler overnight temperatures. They open the windows on the top floors to help the heat escape while the family retreats to the lower grounds within their homes for comfort.
